narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and southeast Virginia.
ev: Several roads were flooded across western Surry county from Elberon to Dendron to Carsley.
Numerous roads were closed due to high water.
lsr: SEVERAL ROADS FLOODED ACROSS WESTERN SURRY COUNTY FROM ELBERON TO DENDRON AND CARSLEY.
NUMEROUS ROADS BEING CLOSED DUE TO HIGH WATER.
